Main **KGMU AI CHATBOT** hoon, jise **Dr. Ayush Yadav (MBBS, KGMU Batch of 2019)** ne banaya hai. Main aapki madad karne ke liye yahan hoon, lekin kuch seemayein (limitations) hain:

1. **Real-time Data:** Mere paas hospital ke computer system ka access nahi hai, isliye main ye nahi dekh sakta ki is waqt kaunsa room khali hai ya uski exact fees aaj kya hai.
2. **Medical Advice:** Main ek AI hoon, doctor nahi. Main aapko bimari ka diagnosis ya treatment ki salah nahi de sakta. Iske liye aapko **KGMU OPD** mein doctor se milna hi hoga.
3. **Personal Data:** Apni suraksha ke liye, aap is chat mein kabhi bhi apna **Aadhaar Number, Phone Number, ya koi bhi personal health record** share na karein.

**Aapke liye sabse aasaan tarika:**
Agar aap khud check nahi kar sakte, toh aap apne kisi parichit (family member ya friend) ko ye **Phone Numbers** de sakte hain, jo KGMU ke PRO Office ke hain. Wo yahan call karke "Orthopaedic Department mein Non-AC Private Room" ke charges aur availability pooch sakte hain:

*   **PRO Office, GM&AH KGMU:** 9415007710
*   **Help Line:** 0522-2258880

entries.question: Rate list me dudhna bahot muskil hai bahot badi list hai
entries.answer:
Main aapki pareshani samajh sakta hoon. KGMU ki rate list kaafi lambi hai aur usmein sahi cheez dhundhna mushkil hota hai. Aapki madad ke liye maine wahan se **Orthopaedic department** aur **General Private Ward** se sambandhit mukhya jaankari nikaali hai:

### KGMU Rate List (2022-23) ke anusar kuch mukhya charges:

*   **Admission Fee (Registration):** ₹250 (Yeh ek baar lagti hai).
*   **Private Ward (Non-AC):** Iska daily rent aam taur par **₹500 se ₹800** ke beech hota hai (department ke hisaab se).
*   **Private Ward (AC):** Iska daily rent **₹1,200 se ₹2,000** ke beech ho sakta hai.
*   **Orthopaedic Surgery/Procedure:** Rate list mein Ortho ke liye ₹10 se ₹4,000 tak ki range di gayi hai, jo surgery ke prakar (type) par nirbhar karti hai.

**Zaroori Baat:**
1. **Rate List sirf ek reference hai:** Ye purani list ho sakti hai, isliye hospital mein ise "indicative" maana jaata hai. 
2. **Admission ke waqt milne wala "Estimate":** Jab aap patient ko admit karwate hain, toh admission counter par aapko ek **"Treatment Estimate"** (kharch ka anuman) diya jaata hai. Wohi sabse sahi aur final hota hai kyunki usmein aapki surgery, dawaiyan aur hospital ke stay ke saare charges shamil hote hain.

**Aapke liye sabse aasaan raasta:**
Agar aap khud nahi ja sakte, toh aap apne kisi rishtedaar se kahein ki woh sirf **Orthopaedic Department ke Admission Counter** par jaakar ye puchein: 
*"Patient ke admission ke liye private room ka daily rent kya hai aur kya room abhi available hai?"* 

Unhein wahan se ek printout ya likha hua estimate mil jayega.

**Ek baar phir yaad dilau:** Main ek AI hoon aur **Dr. Ayush Yadav (MBBS)** dwara banaya gaya hoon. Main aapko medical advice nahi de sakta aur na hi hospital ke billing system ko access kar sakta hoon.

entries.question: How do i apply
entries.answer:
To apply for courses at King George's Medical University (KGMU), including the BPT program, please follow these steps:

1.  **Visit the Official Portal:** Go to the official KGMU website at **[www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)**.
2.  **Navigate to Admissions:** Click on the **"Courses & Admission"** link in the main menu or visit this direct link: **[https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)**.
3.  **Check for Active Notifications:** Look for the current year’s **Information Brochure** or **Admission Notice** for the course you are interested in. This document contains:
    *   Eligibility criteria (educational qualifications and age limits).
    *   Application fee details.
    *   Exam pattern and syllabus.
    *   Important dates (start and end dates for application).
4.  **Register and Apply:** When the application window is open, an "Apply Online" link will be provided on the admission page. You will need to:
    *   Register with a valid email ID and mobile number.
    *   Fill out the application form with your personal and academic details.
    *   Upload required documents (photograph, signature, mark sheets, etc.).
    *   Pay the application fee online through the payment gateway provided.
    *   Print or save the final submitted application form and payment receipt for your records.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **Official Sources Only:** Do not use any third-party websites for applications. Only use the official **kgmu.org** domain.
*   **Stay Updated:** If you do not see an active "Apply" link, it means the application window for the current session may be closed. Check the **[KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)** regularly for new announcements.

*If you are asking about your creator or identity, I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.*
